_about: Narration for the Storyraise Donor Signals walkthrough. `text` is what viewers read in captions; [[cue:name]] markers are stripped before TTS and become timestamps visuals land on. `respell` maps a caption word to how the voice should say it (applied to the TTS text only). Every figure is read from fixtures/donor-signals.json, the frozen wrenfield-demo payload. Labels match the product UI. American English, no em dashes.

scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: You know some of your donors need to hear from you this week. [[cue:question]]The hard part is knowing which ones. [[cue:brand]]Donor Signals scores everyone you have, every day.

scenes.title: How the year is going
scenes.text: [[cue:strip]]It opens with three numbers. [[cue:retention]]How many of last year's donors came back. [[cue:fytd]]What you have raised this year, with the donor count beside it, so a good year on a shrinking list says so. [[cue:firstyear]]And how many first-time donors gave again.

scenes.title: Six groups
scenes.text: [[cue:tiles]]Then six groups. Every donor sits in one. [[cue:money]]And under every count is what is at stake, so seventeen new gifts worth four thousand dollars does not look the same as seventy-one donors slipping away with seventy-one thousand behind them.

scenes.title: At risk, their own rhythm
scenes.text: [[cue:atrisk]]At risk is the one most tools get wrong. [[cue:cadence]]Storyraise measures each donor against their own rhythm. A monthly donor who has missed three gifts is late. An annual donor who gave in November is not. [[cue:sorted]]And the list leads with the money.

scenes.title: Why now
scenes.text: [[cue:row]]Every row says why this person, now. [[cue:reason]]No gift in four months, and they usually give every two. [[cue:reads]]Then what you already know: what they have given, and whether they read what you send. [[cue:moat]]Thirty-four of these seventy-one stopped giving and still open your reports.

scenes.title: Read it or compare it
scenes.text: [[cue:views]]Overview reads as a list of people. [[cue:table]]Table puts the same donors in a grid you can sort. Whichever you use is remembered.

scenes.title: Make something
scenes.text: [[cue:actions]]Then the part that is the point. [[cue:cards]]Two things you can make for the group in front of you, written for that group. Record one thank-you for everyone who just gave, or put together a report showing what the money is doing.

scenes.title: Three routes
scenes.text: [[cue:dialog]]Open one and you pick how to make it. [[cue:routes]]A draft written for this group, a template, or a report you have already published. [[cue:carry]]Storyraise saves the group as a list and opens Send, and each donor gets their own personalized link.

scenes.title: Giving health
scenes.text: [[cue:health]]Further down, the year in full. [[cue:bands]]Retention by gift size is the table that changes plans. Donors under a hundred dollars come back a third of the time. Donors over a thousand come back nearly nine times in ten.

scenes.title: Explore
scenes.text: [[cue:cta]]The demo below is the real page with sample data. Click through the groups and see what your own week would look like.
